summary: Expanded the universe around the software chokepoint where enterprise AI agents must connect to systems of record, governed data, identity, workflow permissions, audit trails, and observability before production deployment. The strongest candidates are not generic model providers; they control workflow surfaces, data context, access control, or operational telemetry. This pass favors US-listed companies with plausible direct exposure to enterprise agentic deployment and excludes hardware, power, and cloud infrastructure names covered by other funnel layers.
